summary: Foresight Autonomous Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a securities exchange agreement with VisionWave Holdings (Nasdaq: VWAV). VisionWave will acquire 46% of Foresight's shares in Stage 1 for ~$15.48M in VisionWave stock, followed by an additional 6% in Stage 2 for ~$2.02M in stock, for an aggregate $17.5M (52% ownership). The stock-for-stock consideration includes a 65% economic value protection mechanism for two years. Stage 2 is conditional on a pilot project milestone. VisionWave gets board representation (2+1 seats). No break fee or premium was disclosed. Watch for shareholder approval and Form S-1 registration filing.
